# Md Shahed | Official Website

> This is the official website of Md Shahed (also written as MD Shahed, Md. Shahed, Mohammad Shahed, Shahed, or শাহেদ) — a Bangladeshi web developer and entrepreneur based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and Founder & CEO of Shahed IT.

Md Shahed builds modern websites, e-commerce platforms, and digital brands using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and SEO. Official domain: https://shahed.com.bd. Company: https://shahedit.com.

This personal brand is not affiliated with other public figures who share the same name.

## Identity

- Official website: https://shahed.com.bd
- Company: https://shahedit.com (Shahed IT)
- Name variants: Md Shahed; MD Shahed; Md. Shahed; Mohammad Shahed; Shahed; শাহেদ
- Role: Web Developer & Entrepreneur; Founder & CEO of Shahed IT
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh

- Phone: +880 1823-378888
